howItWorks.question: How does WhyNot find bugs automatically?
howItWorks.answer: WhyNot deploys autonomous AI agents that navigate your web application like real users. They click buttons, fill forms, explore navigation paths, and monitor for console errors, broken layouts, failed API calls, and visual regressions — all without you writing a single line of test code.

integration.question: How do I integrate WhyNot with my app?
integration.answer: Just provide your app's URL. WhyNot works with any web application regardless of the tech stack — React, Vue, Angular, Next.js, Django, Rails, Laravel, WordPress, or any other framework. No SDK or code changes required.

pricing.question: Is there a free tier?
pricing.answer: Yes! Our free tier includes 50 test runs per month, up to 3 projects, and full access to AI bug detection and Playwright code generation. No credit card required to get started.

security.question: Is my application data secure?
security.answer: Absolutely. WhyNot runs tests in isolated browser sandboxes. We never store your application data, credentials, or user information. All connections are encrypted with TLS, and we are SOC 2 compliant.

accuracy.question: How accurate is the bug detection?
accuracy.answer: Our AI achieves a 99.2% accuracy rate with very low false positives. Each reported bug includes screenshots, console logs, network traces, and generated Playwright code so you can verify and reproduce it instantly.
